title: What's New: E-Documents and E-Shipments (2025 release wave 2)

features.name: E-Shipments
features.description: Electronic version of shipment documents that can be sent to authorities in countries where this is mandatory or required, supporting countries like Mexico and India where e-shipments are already mandatory.
caveats: Authorities in different countries use different expressions for shipment documents
Currently in the system there is not specific file for specific localization, this is just example for demos

features.name: E-Transfer Shipments
features.description: Extension of e-documents framework to transfer shipment documents between locations, allowing automatic sending based on location configuration similar to customer-level setup.
caveats: Configuration setup required at location level

features.name: Sales Shipment E-Documents
features.description: Electronic documents created from posted sales shipments, integrating with document sending profiles and workflow for automatic export and delivery via email.
caveats: Requires document sending profile configuration with e-documents enabled

features.name: E-Documents Transfer Document Sending Profile
features.description: New field added to locations allowing configuration of e-documents transfer document sending profile, enabling automatic posting and sending of transfer orders based on setup.
caveats: Must be configured on the location for transfer orders to be picked up automatically

features.name: Retroactive E-Document Creation from Posted Documents
features.description: Ability to create electronic documents from already posted documents that were not initially set up with e-documents, allowing users to generate and send e-documents after the fact.
caveats: Customer must have appropriate document sending profile configured to use e-documents before creation will succeed

features.name: E-Document Export and Email Workflow
features.description: Workflow automation that exports electronic documents and sends them via email alongside PDF attachments when e-document service status changes to exported.
caveats: Requires manual workflow setup to enable email delivery

features.name: Post and Send with E-Document Attachments
features.description: Enhancement to post and send functionality allowing users to select electronic documents and PDFs as email attachments when sending invoices and other documents.
